objective.statement: On HomeView, display a digital clock widget (digits only, no clock face, e.g. 14:54.00) that the user can switch between 12 hour and 24 hour view.

complexity.rationale: New pure formatter, a new ticking and interactive component, and a HomeView change; no external contract, dependency or store change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: HomeView renders a clock widget showing the current local time as digits only, with no clock face.
The clock shows hours, minutes and seconds in the pattern of the owner's example (14:54.00): two-digit hours, a colon, two-digit minutes, a dot, two-digit seconds.
A control switches the clock between 24 hour view (default, e.g. 14:54.00) and 12 hour view (e.g. 02:54.00 PM), and switches back; the control exposes which view is active.
The clock updates every second while mounted and stops its timer on unmount.
12 hour view maps midnight to 12 AM and noon to 12 PM; 24 hour view shows 00 to 23.

in.statement: A pure clock formatting helper, a Clock component with local view state and a one second tick, its testIds file, colocated unit and component tests, and rendering the Clock in HomeView.

out.statement: Analog clock face, time zone selection, persisting the 12/24 choice, store changes, new dependencies, date display, e2e tests, changes to existing HomeView behaviour.

observations.statement: The example 14:54.00 is read literally as HH:MM.SS (seconds after a dot). 12 hour view uses the same pattern plus an AM/PM suffix, e.g. 02:54.00 PM. Time is the browser's local time.
The 24 hour view is the default, and the choice is local component state that resets on reload; it is not written to the Zustand store or localStorage.
The clock is placed in its own section below the header and above ModeToggle in HomeView, using the existing section styling of ModeToggle. Existing HomeView tests stay unchanged.

Follow repository conventions: components in src/components/<name>/ with <Name>.testIds.ts and <Name>.component.test.tsx, helpers in src/lib with *.unit.test.ts, data-id attributes for test ids, AAA test layout, no any.
Timer tests need vitest fake timers; the existing LastUpdatedFooter component is the pattern for the setInterval with cleanup.

provenance.source: New Feature request: A 6th clock attempt - display a clock widget on HomeView.tsx, switchable between 12 and 24 hour view, digits only (e.g. 14:54.00), no clock face

approvals.requirement: The owner must approve the plan before any test or production file is written.

decisions.rationale: Plan approval is required for this run; the plan is saved and implementation has not started.

capabilityOwners.rationale: The 12/24 choice and the current time are component-local; useState plus a useEffect interval.
Not used: nothing else needs the clock choice and it is not persisted (o-2).
No remote data in this slice.

unit.rationale: 12/24 hour formatting, zero padding and midnight/noon edges are isolated pure logic.

component.rationale: Rendering, the view switch, the per second tick and HomeView placement are component behaviour.

integration.rationale: No cross-module or API flow; npm run test is run as regression.

e2e.rationale: Small self-contained widget with no new route or vertical flow; component tests cover the behaviour.

increments.behavior: Pure formatClock(date, hourCycle) returns HH:MM.SS for 24 hour and hh:MM.SS AM/PM for 12 hour.
Clock component shows the formatted current time, ticks each second, cleans up its timer, and a toggle button switches 24h and 12h views; HomeView renders it.
increments.doneWhen: t-2 passes and the full suite stays green.

tests.description: formatClock: 24h padding (00:05.09, 14:54.00), 12h with AM/PM, midnight is 12 AM, noon is 12 PM.
Clock renders the time in 24h by default, toggles to 12h and back via a button with aria-pressed, advances after one second with fake timers, and clears its interval on unmount.
HomeView renders the clock widget; existing HomeView tests are unchanged.
